component.name: IPTVPanel
component.script:
sub init() m.m3uUrl = "pkg:/data/channels.json" m.rowH = 42 m.maxRows = 9 m.leftW = 300 m.cBg = "0x0D1117FF" m.cCard = "0x161B22FF" m.cSel = "0x238636FF" m.cText = "0xE6EDF3FF" m.cSub = "0x8B949EFF" m.cBorder = "0x30363DFF" m.cBlue = "0x58A6FFFF" m.cGreen = "0x3FB950FF" m.cRed = "0xF85149FF" m.allChannels = [] m.channelsByGroup = {} m.categoryCounts = {} m.channelsByPrefix = {} m.smartCollections = {} m.collectionNames = [ "XXX", "Sports", "UFC", "WWE", "Boxing", "NFL", "NBA", "MLB", "NHL", "Soccer", "Motorsports", "Tennis", "Cricket", "Rugby", "Golf", "Olympics", "Jackie Chan Films", "Transporter", "Two and a Half Men", "Lord of the Rings", "Batman", "The Big Bang Theory", "Curb Your Enthusiasm", "BBC Earth", "24/7 Channels", "HBO", "CINEMAX", "SHOWTIME", "STARZ", "NETFLIX", "NEWS CHANNELS", "Series" ] m.visibleCollectionNames = m.collectionNames m.webAppUrl = "" m.guideApiUrl = "" m.customLogoEnabled = false m.webToolsVisible = false m.wordSplitter = CreateObject("roRegex", "[^a-z0-9]+", "i") m.favoritesChannels = [] m.favoriteCount = 0 m.tolkienChannels = [] m.groups = [] m.groupIdx = 1 m.groupOffset = 0 m.filtered = [] m.streamOffset= 0 m.streamCursor= 0 m.focusSide = "group" m.loaded = false m.aboutVisible = false m.searchQuery = "" m.favorites = {} m.favoriteSection = CreateObject("roRegistrySection", "MasterChiefFavorites") loadFavorites() loadAppConfig() buildChrome() m.task = CreateObject("roSGNode", "M3UTask") m.task.observeField("batchIndex", "onData") m.task.observeField("complete", "onPlaylistComplete") m.task.observeField("error", "onError") m.guideTask = CreateObject("roSGNode", "EPGTask") m.guideTask.observeField("listingsJson", "onGuideData") m.guideTask.observeField("error", "onGuideError") m.guideTimer = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.guideTimer.duration = 1800 m.guideTimer.repeat = true m.guideTimer.observeField("fire", "onGuideTimer") if m.guideApiUrl <> "" then m.guideTask.url = m.guideApiUrl if m.guideApiUrl <> "" then m.guideTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub addSportsCollections(channel as Object, searchableText as String) tokens = {} for each word in m.wordSplitter.Split(searchableText) if word <> "" then tokens[word] = true end for category = "" if channel.category <> invalid then category = LCase(channel.category) groupName = "" if channel.group <> invalid then groupName = LCase(channel.group) isSport = category = "sport" or category = "sports" or groupName = "sport" or groupName = "sports"
if tokens.DoesExist("ufc") or Instr(1, searchableText, "ultimate fighting championship") > 0 m.smartCollections["UFC"].push(channel) isSport = true end if if tokens.DoesExist("wwe") or tokens.DoesExist("wwf") or tokens.DoesExist("wrestling") m.smartCollections["WWE"].push(channel) isSport = true end if if tokens.DoesExist("boxing") or tokens.DoesExist("boxer") or Instr(1, searchableText, "fight night") > 0 m.smartCollections["Boxing"].push(channel) isSport = true end if if tokens.DoesExist("nfl") or Instr(1, searchableText, "national football league") > 0 m.smartCollections["NFL"].push(channel) isSport = true end if if tokens.DoesExist("nba") or Instr(1, searchableText, "national basketball association") > 0 m.smartCollections["NBA"].push(channel) isSport = true end if if tokens.DoesExist("mlb") or Instr(1, searchableText, "major league baseball") > 0 m.smartCollections["MLB"].push(channel) isSport = true end if if tokens.DoesExist("nhl") or Instr(1, searchableText, "national hockey league") > 0 m.smartCollections["NHL"].push(channel) isSport = true end if if tokens.DoesExist("soccer") or tokens.DoesExist("fifa") or tokens.DoesExist("uefa") or tokens.DoesExist("football") or Instr(1, searchableText, "premier league") > 0 or Instr(1, searchableText, "champions league") > 0 or Instr(1, searchableText, "la liga") > 0 m.smartCollections["Soccer"].push(channel) isSport = true end if if tokens.DoesExist("nascar") or tokens.DoesExist("motorsport") or tokens.DoesExist("motorsports") or tokens.DoesExist("motogp") or tokens.DoesExist("f1") or tokens.DoesExist("indycar") or Instr(1, searchableText, "formula 1") > 0 m.smartCollections["Motorsports"].push(channel) isSport = true end if if tokens.DoesExist("tennis") or tokens.DoesExist("wimbledon") or tokens.DoesExist("atp") or tokens.DoesExist("wta") m.smartCollections["Tennis"].push(channel) isSport = true end if if tokens.DoesExist("cricket") or tokens.DoesExist("ipl") m.smartCollections["Cricket"].push(channel) isSport = true end if if tokens.DoesExist("rugby") then m.smartCollections["Rugby"].push(channel) isSport = true end if if tokens.DoesExist("golf") or tokens.DoesExist("pga") or tokens.DoesExist("lpga") m.smartCollections["Golf"].push(channel) isSport = true end if if tokens.DoesExist("olympic") or tokens.DoesExist("olympics") m.smartCollections["Olympics"].push(channel) isSport = true end if if isSport then m.smartCollections["Sports"].push(channel) end sub
sub loadAppConfig() configText = ReadAsciiFile("pkg:/data/app_config.json") if configText = invalid then return config = ParseJson(configText) if config = invalid then return if config.web_app_url <> invalid then m.webAppUrl = config.web_app_url if config.guide_api_url <> invalid then m.guideApiUrl = config.guide_api_url if config.custom_logo = true then m.customLogoEnabled = true if type(config.collection_order) <> "roArray" then return configuredCollections = [] for each requestedName in config.collection_order for each supportedName in m.collectionNames if requestedName = supportedName alreadyAdded = false for each addedName in configuredCollections if addedName = requestedName then alreadyAdded = true end for if not alreadyAdded then configuredCollections.push(requestedName) exit for end if end for end for m.visibleCollectionNames = configuredCollections end sub
sub buildChrome() bg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bg.translation = [0, 0] bg.width = 1280 bg.height = 720 bg.color = m.cBg
sideBar = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") sideBar.translation = [20, 8] sideBar.width = m.leftW sideBar.height = 580 sideBar.color = m.cCard
sideHdr = m.top.createChild("Label") sideHdr.translation = [82, 20] sideHdr.text = "MASTERCHIEF - ECHO STARLITE" sideHdr.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" sideHdr.color = m.cBlue sideHdr.width = 210 if m.customLogoEnabled logo = m.top.createChild("Poster") logo.translation = [34, 12] logo.width = 42 logo.height = 38 logo.uri = "pkg:/images/custom_logo.png" end if m.clockLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.clockLbl.translation = [1000, 16] m.clockLbl.width = 250 m.clockLbl.height = 26 m.clockLbl.horizAlign = "right" m.clockLbl.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" m.clockLbl.color = m.cText m.clockTimer = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.clockTimer.duration = 30 m.clockTimer.repeat = true m.clockTimer.observeField("fire", "onClockTick") m.clockTimer.control = "start" updateClock()
m.groupList = m.top.createChild("Group") m.groupList.translation = [20, 46]
chArea = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") chArea.translation = [330, 8] chArea.width = 930 chArea.height = 580 chArea.color = m.cCard
chHdr = m.top.createChild("Label") chHdr.translation = [344, 16] chHdr.text = "BROWSE YOUR PLAYLIST" chHdr.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" chHdr.color = m.cBlue
m.countLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.countLbl.translation = [900, 16] m.countLbl.text = "" m.countLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.countLbl.color = m.cSub
m.streamList = m.top.createChild("Group") m.streamList.translation = [330, 46]
m.statusLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.statusLbl.translation = [34, 598] m.statusLbl.text = "Loading playlist..." m.statusLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.statusLbl.color = m.cSub m.statusLbl.width = 1220
m.detailLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.detailLbl.translation = [34, 624] m.detailLbl.width = 1210 m.detailLbl.height = 78 m.detailLbl.wrap = true m.detailLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.detailLbl.color = m.cSub
m.aboutOverlay = m.top.createChild("Group") m.aboutOverlay.visible = false overlayBg = m.aboutOverlay.createChild("Rectangle") overlayBg.width = 1280 overlayBg.height = 720 overlayBg.color = "0x0D1117FF" aboutAccent = m.aboutOverlay.createChild("Rectangle") aboutAccent.translation = [250, 120] aboutAccent.width = 780 aboutAccent.height = 4 aboutAccent.color = m.cBlue aboutTitle = m.aboutOverlay.createChild("Label") aboutTitle.translation = [250, 155] aboutTitle.width = 780 aboutTitle.height = 70 aboutTitle.text = "MASTERCHIEF - ECHO STARLITE" aboutTitle.font = "font:LargeBoldSystemFont" aboutTitle.color = m.cText aboutBody = m.aboutOverlay.createChild("Label") aboutBody.translation = [250, 255] aboutBody.width = 780 aboutBody.height = 200 aboutBody.text = "A Roku-native edition of the MasterChief app." + chr(10) + chr(10) + "Browse your playlist and play supported streams with the built-in Roku player." + chr(10) + chr(10) + "Echo Chat, code tools, builds, and other server-backed features remain available in the MasterChief web app." + chr(10) + chr(10) + "Press BACK to return to your playlist." aboutBody.font = "font:MediumSystemFont" aboutBody.color = m.cText aboutBody.wrap = true aboutFooter = m.aboutOverlay.createChild("Label") aboutFooter.translation = [250, 620] aboutFooter.width = 780 aboutFooter.height = 50 aboutFooter.text = "JOEY BALLZ" aboutFooter.horizAlign = "center" aboutFooter.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" aboutFooter.color = m.cBlue
m.webToolsOverlay = m.top.createChild("Group") m.webToolsOverlay.visible = false toolsBg = m.webToolsOverlay.createChild("Rectangle") toolsBg.width = 1280 toolsBg.height = 720 toolsBg.color = "0x0D1117FF" toolsTitle = m.webToolsOverlay.createChild("Label") toolsTitle.translation = [210, 82] toolsTitle.width = 860 toolsTitle.height = 70 toolsTitle.text = "MASTERCHIEF WEB TOOLS LINKS" toolsTitle.font = "font:LargeBoldSystemFont" toolsTitle.color = m.cText toolsBody = m.webToolsOverlay.createChild("Label") toolsBody.translation = [210, 175] toolsBody.width = 860 toolsBody.height = 390 toolsBody.font = "font:MediumSystemFont" toolsBody.color = m.cText toolsBody.wrap = true toolsBody.text = "These pages require a web browser and JavaScript. Open the links on a computer, phone, or tablet; Roku cannot display the full pages." + chr(10) + chr(10) + webToolLinkText(m.webAppUrl) toolsFooter = m.webToolsOverlay.createChild("Label") toolsFooter.translation = [210, 610] toolsFooter.width = 860 toolsFooter.height = 50 toolsFooter.text = "BACK returns to your playlist." toolsFooter.horizAlign = "center" toolsFooter.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" toolsFooter.color = m.cBlue end sub
sub loadFavorites() if m.favoriteSection = invalid then return keys = m.favoriteSection.GetKeyList() if keys = invalid then return for each key in keys url = m.favoriteSection.Read(key) if url <> invalid and url <> "" m.favorites[url] = true m.favoriteCount = m.favoriteCount + 1 end if end for end sub
function load(args as Dynamic) if m.loaded then return invalid resetPlaylist() m.statusLbl.text = "Downloading playlist..." m.statusLbl.color = m.cSub m.task.url = "" m.task.url = m.m3uUrl end function
sub onClockTick() updateClock() end sub
sub updateClock() if m.clockLbl = invalid then return now = CreateObject("roDateTime") m.clockLbl.text = now.AsDateString("long") + " " + now.AsTimeString() end sub
sub onGuideTimer() if m.guideApiUrl = "" then return m.guideTask.url = "" m.guideTask.url = m.guideApiUrl end sub
sub onGuideData() response = ParseJson(m.guideTask.listingsJson) if response = invalid or type(response.programmes) <> "roAssociativeArray" then return for each channel in m.allChannels channelId = channel.tvg_id if channelId <> invalid and response.programmes[channelId] <> invalid listings = response.programmes[channelId] if listings.now <> invalid then channel.program_now = listings.now if listings.next <> invalid then channel.program_next = listings.next end if end for renderStreams() updateDetails() end sub
sub onGuideError() if m.guideTask.error <> "" and m.statusLbl <> invalid m.statusLbl.text = "Live guide refresh failed: " + m.guideTask.error m.statusLbl.color = m.cRed end if end sub
sub resetPlaylist() m.allChannels = [] m.channelsByGroup = {} m.categoryCounts = {} m.channelsByPrefix = {} m.smartCollections = {} m.tolkienChannels = [] m.favoritesChannels = [] m.providerGroups = {} m.groups = [] m.playlistLoadFailed = false m.lastBatchIndex = 0 m.loaded = false m.task.batchAck = 0 m.task.batchIndex = 0 m.task.complete = false m.task.channelsJson = "" m.task.error = "" for each collectionName in m.collectionNames m.smartCollections[collectionName] = [] end for end sub
function webToolLinkText(baseUrl as String) as String routes = [ {name: "MasterChief Home", path: "/"}, {name: "Web IDE", path: "/web_ide"}, {name: "Terraform Wizard", path: "/tf_wizard"}, {name: "Azure CAF Generator", path: "/arm_creator"}, {name: "MasterChief Code UI", path: "/masterchief_code_ui"} ] result = "" for each route in routes target = route.path if baseUrl <> "" then target = baseUrl + route.path if result <> "" then result = result + chr(10) + chr(10) result = result + route.name + chr(10) + target end for if baseUrl = "" result = "Set a web app URL in the Roku Builder to show complete links." + chr(10) + chr(10) + result end if return result end function
sub onError() msg = m.task.error if msg = "" then return m.playlistLoadFailed = true m.statusLbl.text = "Error: " + msg m.statusLbl.color = m.cRed end sub
sub onData() batchIndex = m.task.batchIndex if batchIndex <= m.lastBatchIndex then return cj = m.task.channelsJson if cj = "" m.playlistLoadFailed = true m.task.batchAck = batchIndex m.statusLbl.text = "Error: Roku received an empty playlist data batch." m.statusLbl.color = m.cRed return end if channels = ParseJson(cj) if channels = invalid or type(channels) <> "roArray" m.playlistLoadFailed = true m.task.batchAck = batchIndex m.statusLbl.text = "Error: Roku could not parse a playlist data batch." m.statusLbl.color = m.cRed return end if for each channel in channels m.allChannels.push(channel) groupName = channel.group if groupName = invalid or groupName = "" then groupName = "Uncategorized" categoryName = channel.category if categoryName = invalid or categoryName = "" then categoryName = groupName if not m.providerGroups.DoesExist(groupName) then m.providerGroups[groupName] = true channel.search_text = buildSearchText(channel) addChannelToIndex(groupName, channel) if categoryName <> groupName then addChannelToIndex(categoryName, channel) indexSearchPrefixes(channel) if isTolkienMovie(channel) then m.tolkienChannels.push(channel) addToSmartCollections(channel) if m.favorites.doesExist(channel.url) then m.favoritesChannels.push(channel) end for m.lastBatchIndex = batchIndex m.task.batchAck = batchIndex m.statusLbl.text = "Loading playlist... " + stri(m.allChannels.count()).trim() + " channels" m.statusLbl.color = m.cSub end sub
sub onPlaylistComplete() if not m.task.complete or m.playlistLoadFailed then return m.favoriteCount = m.favoritesChannels.count() m.groups = ["About Me", "Web Tools Links", "Search", "All Channels", "Favorites"] for each collectionName in m.visibleCollectionNames m.groups.push(collectionName) end for providerGroups = [] for each group in m.providerGroups providerGroups.push(group) end for providerGroups.sort() for each group in providerGroups if not hasGroupName(group) m.groups.push(group) end if end for m.groupIdx = 3 m.groupOffset = 0 m.loaded = true total = m.allChannels.count() gc = providerGroups.count() m.statusLbl.text = stri(total).trim() + " channels | " + stri(gc).trim() + " categories | OK plays | Play toggles Favorite | * controls" m.statusLbl.color = m.cGreen filterGroup() renderGroups() renderStreams() end sub
sub filterGroup() m.filtered = [] m.streamOffset = 0 m.streamCursor = 0 if m.groups.count() = 0 then return g = m.groups[m.groupIdx] if g = "About Me" m.countLbl.text = "MasterChief on Roku" updateDetails() return end if if g = "Web Tools Links" m.filtered = [] m.countLbl.text = "Web links" updateDetails() return end if if g = "Search" m.countLbl.text = "Type to search" updateDetails() return end if candidates = m.allChannels if g = "Lord of the Rings" candidates = m.tolkienChannels else if m.smartCollections[g] <> invalid candidates = m.smartCollections[g] else if g = "Favorites" candidates = m.favoritesChannels else if g <> "All Channels" candidates = m.channelsByGroup[g] if candidates = invalid then candidates = [] end if for each ch in candidates if matchesSearch(ch) then m.filtered.push(ch) end for if g = "Lord of the Rings" prioritized = [] for rank = 0 to 3 for each ch in m.filtered if playbackFormatRank(ch) = rank then prioritized.push(ch) end for end for m.filtered = prioritized end if m.countLbl.text = stri(m.filtered.count()).trim() + " ch" updateDetails() end sub
sub addChannelToIndex(groupName as String, channel as Object) if m.channelsByGroup[groupName] = invalid m.channelsByGroup[groupName] = [] m.categoryCounts[groupName] = 0 end if m.channelsByGroup[groupName].push(channel) m.categoryCounts[groupName] = m.categoryCounts[groupName] + 1 end sub
function hasGroupName(groupName as String) as Boolean for each existingGroup in m.groups if existingGroup = groupName then return true end for return false end function
sub indexSearchPrefixes(channel as Object) seen = {} words = m.wordSplitter.Split(channel.search_text) for each word in words if Len(word) >= 3 prefix = Left(word, 3) if not seen.DoesExist(prefix) seen[prefix] = true if m.channelsByPrefix[prefix] = invalid then m.channelsByPrefix[prefix] = [] m.channelsByPrefix[prefix].push(channel) end if end if end for end sub
sub addToSmartCollections(channel as Object) text = channel.search_text if isAdultChannel(channel, text) then m.smartCollections["XXX"].push(channel) addSportsCollections(channel, text) if isJackieChanFilm(text) then m.smartCollections["Jackie Chan Films"].push(channel) if Instr(1, text, "transporter") > 0 then m.smartCollections["Transporter"].push(channel) if Instr(1, text, "two and a half men") > 0 or Instr(1, text, "two & a half men") > 0 m.smartCollections["Two and a Half Men"].push(channel) end if if Instr(1, text, "batman") > 0 then m.smartCollections["Batman"].push(channel) if Instr(1, text, "big bang theory") > 0 then m.smartCollections["The Big Bang Theory"].push(channel) if Instr(1, text, "curb your enthusiasm") > 0 then m.smartCollections["Curb Your Enthusiasm"].push(channel) if Instr(1, text, "bbc earth") > 0 then m.smartCollections["BBC Earth"].push(channel) if Instr(1, text, "24/7") > 0 or Instr(1, text, "24 7") > 0 or Instr(1, text, "24-7") > 0 m.smartCollections["24/7 Channels"].push(channel) end if if Instr(1, text, "hbo") > 0 then m.smartCollections["HBO"].push(channel) if Instr(1, text, "cinemax") > 0 then m.smartCollections["CINEMAX"].push(channel) if Instr(1, text, "showtime") > 0 then m.smartCollections["SHOWTIME"].push(channel) if Instr(1, text, "starz") > 0 then m.smartCollections["STARZ"].push(channel) if Instr(1, text, "netflix") > 0 then m.smartCollections["NETFLIX"].push(channel) if isNewsChannel(channel, text) then m.smartCollections["NEWS CHANNELS"].push(channel) if LCase(channel.category) = "series" or LCase(channel.group) = "series" m.smartCollections["Series"].push(channel) end if end sub
function isJackieChanFilm(searchableText as String) as Boolean if Instr(1, searchableText, "jackie chan") > 0 then return true filmTitles = [ "armour of god", "around the world in 80 days", "city hunter", "drunken master", "fearless hyena", "legend of drunken master", "new police story", "police story", "project a", "rumble in the bronx", "rush hour", "shanghai knights", "shanghai noon", "snake in the eagle's shadow", "the foreigner", "the medallion", "the myth", "the tuxedo", "wheels on meals", "who am i" ] for each filmTitle in filmTitles if Instr(1, searchableText, filmTitle) > 0 then return true end for return false end function
function isAdultChannel(channel as Object, searchableText as String) as Boolean lowerText = LCase(searchableText) channelGroup = "" if channel.group <> invalid then channelGroup = LCase(channel.group) channelCategory = "" if channel.category <> invalid then channelCategory = LCase(channel.category) if channelGroup = "movies" or channelCategory = "movies" then return false if channelGroup = "adult" or channelGroup = "xxx" or channelGroup = "x-rated" or channelCategory = "adult" or channelCategory = "xxx" or channelCategory = "x-rated" return true end if if Instr(1, lowerText, "18+") > 0 then return true if channel.name <> invalid and Instr(1, channel.name, "XXX") > 0 then return true if Instr(1, lowerText, "x-rated") > 0 or Instr(1, lowerText, "big ass") > 0 or Instr(1, lowerText, "blow job") > 0 or Instr(1, lowerText, "blowjob") > 0 or Instr(1, lowerText, "big tits") > 0 return true end if words = m.wordSplitter.Split(lowerText) for each word in words if word = "porn" or word = "pornography" or word = "erotic" or word = "hentai" or word = "playboy" or word = "hustler" or word = "brazzers" or word = "milf" or word = "anal" or word = "blondes" or word = "brunettes" or word = "babes" return true end if end for return false end function
function isNewsChannel(channel as Object, searchableText as String) as Boolean if LCase(channel.category) = "news" then return true if Instr(1, searchableText, "news") > 0 or Instr(1, searchableText, "cnn") > 0 or Instr(1, searchableText, "msnbc") > 0 or Instr(1, searchableText, "cnbc") > 0 or Instr(1, searchableText, "bloomberg") > 0 or Instr(1, searchableText, "al jazeera") > 0 or Instr(1, searchableText, "sky news") > 0 or Instr(1, searchableText, "fox news") > 0 return true end if return false end function
function buildSearchText(channel as Object) as String text = LCase(channel.name) if channel.group <> invalid then text = text + " " + LCase(channel.group) if channel.category <> invalid then text = text + " " + LCase(channel.category) if channel.tvg_id <> invalid then text = text + " " + LCase(channel.tvg_id) if channel.metadata <> invalid for each key in channel.metadata keyName = LCase(key) value = channel.metadata[key] if keyName <> "tvg_logo" and keyName <> "logo" and keyName <> "url" and value <> invalid if type(value) = "roString" or type(value) = "String" text = text + " " + LCase(value) end if end if end for end if return text end function
function isTolkienMovie(channel as Object) as Boolean title = LCase(channel.name) return Instr(1, title, "lord of the rings") > 0 or Instr(1, title, "hobbit") > 0 end function
function playbackFormatRank(channel as Object) as Integer format = channel.stream_format if format = invalid then return 3 format = LCase(format) if format = "hls" then return 0 if format = "mp2ts" then return 1 if format = "mp4" then return 2 return 3 end function
function matchesSearch(channel as Object) as Boolean if m.searchQuery = "" then return true return Instr(1, channel.search_text, m.searchQuery) > 0 end function
function searchCandidates(query as String) as Object bestPrefix = "" words = m.wordSplitter.Split(query) for each word in words if Len(word) >= 3 and Len(word) > Len(bestPrefix) bestPrefix = Left(word, 3) end if end for if bestPrefix <> "" and m.channelsByPrefix[bestPrefix] <> invalid return m.channelsByPrefix[bestPrefix] end if return m.allChannels end function
sub updateDetails() index = m.streamOffset + m.streamCursor if index < 0 or index >= m.filtered.count() m.detailLbl.text = "EXTINF details appear here when a channel is selected." return end if channel = m.filtered[index] tvgId = "not provided" if channel.tvg_id <> invalid and channel.tvg_id <> "" then tvgId = channel.tvg_id groupName = channel.group if groupName = invalid or groupName = "" then groupName = "Uncategorized" logoState = "not provided" if channel.logo <> invalid and channel.logo <> "" then logoState = "available" duration = "-1" if channel.duration <> invalid then duration = channel.duration format = "unknown" if channel.stream_format <> invalid then format = channel.stream_format genre = "" if channel.metadata <> invalid genre = channel.metadata.genre if genre = invalid then genre = channel.metadata.tvg_genre if genre = invalid then genre = channel.metadata.category if genre = invalid then genre = "" end if metadata = "" if channel.metadata <> invalid and channel.metadata.count() > 0 metadata = formatExtinfMetadata(channel.metadata) end if genreText = "" if genre <> "" then genreText = " | Genre=" + genre m.detailLbl.text = "EXTINF: Group=" + groupName + " | TVG-ID=" + tvgId + " | Logo=" + logoState + " | Duration=" + duration + " | Format=" + format + genreText + metadata end sub
function formatExtinfMetadata(attributes as Object) as String result = "" keys = ["tvg_name", "group_title", "tvg_language", "tvg_country", "tvg_type", "genre", "tvg_genre", "tvg_rating", "tvg_director", "tvg_actor", "category"] labels = ["tvg-name", "group-title", "tvg-language", "tvg-country", "tvg-type", "genre", "tvg-genre", "tvg-rating", "tvg-director", "tvg-actor", "category"] for i = 0 to keys.count() - 1 value = attributes[keys[i]] if value <> invalid and value <> "" if result <> "" then result = result + " | " result = result + labels[i] + "=" + value end if end for if result = "" then return "" return " | EXTINF attributes: " + result end function
function countGroup(groupName as String) as Integer if groupName = "About Me" then return 0 if groupName = "Search" then return 0 if groupName = "All Channels" then return m.allChannels.count() if groupName = "Lord of the Rings" then return m.tolkienChannels.count() if groupName = "Favorites" then return m.favoriteCount if m.smartCollections[groupName] <> invalid then return m.smartCollections[groupName].count() count = m.categoryCounts[groupName] if count = invalid then return 0 return count end function
function openOptionsDialog() as Boolean dialog = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Dialog") dialog.title = "Playlist controls" dialog.message = "Search, organize, or manage the selected channel." dialog.buttons = ["Search channels", "Lord of the Rings", "All channels", "Favorites", "Add/remove favorite", "Clear search", "About Me", "MasterChief dashboard", "Close"] dialog.observeField("buttonSelected", "onOptionsSelected") m.top.getScene().dialog = dialog return true end function
sub onOptionsSelected(msg as Object) index = msg.GetData() m.top.getScene().dialog = invalid if index = 0 openSearchDialog() else if index = 1 m.searchQuery = "" selectGroup("Lord of the Rings") else if index = 2 m.searchQuery = "" selectGroup("All Channels") else if index = 3 m.searchQuery = "" selectGroup("Favorites") else if index = 4 toggleFavorite() else if index = 5 m.searchQuery = "" filterGroup() renderStreams() m.statusLbl.text = "Search cleared." else if index = 6 openAboutMe() else if index = 7 m.top.openCloudDashboard = true end if end sub
sub openAboutMe() m.aboutVisible = true m.aboutOverlay.visible = true end sub
sub openWebTools() m.webToolsVisible = true m.webToolsOverlay.visible = true end sub
sub openSearchDialog() dialog = CreateObject("roSGNode", "KeyboardDialog") dialog.title = "Search channels" dialog.text = m.searchQuery dialog.buttons = ["Search", "Cancel"] dialog.observeField("buttonSelected", "onSearchSelected") m.top.getScene().dialog = dialog end sub
sub onSearchSelected(msg as Object) index = msg.GetData() dialog = m.top.getScene().dialog if index = 0 and dialog <> invalid m.searchQuery = LCase(Trim(dialog.text)) selectGroup("Search") candidates = searchCandidates(m.searchQuery) m.filtered = [] for each channel in candidates if matchesSearch(channel) then m.filtered.push(channel) end for m.streamOffset = 0 m.streamCursor = 0 m.countLbl.text = stri(m.filtered.count()).trim() + " ch" renderStreams() m.statusLbl.text = "Search: " + m.searchQuery end if m.top.getScene().dialog = invalid end sub
sub selectGroup(groupName as String) index = -1 for i = 0 to m.groups.count() - 1 if m.groups[i] = groupName index = i exit for end if end for if index < 0 then return m.groupIdx = index m.groupOffset = 0 m.focusSide = "group" filterGroup() renderGroups() renderStreams() end sub
sub toggleFavorite() if m.favoriteSection = invalid m.statusLbl.text = "Favorites are unavailable on this device." m.statusLbl.color = m.cRed return end if index = m.streamOffset + m.streamCursor if index < 0 or index >= m.filtered.count() m.statusLbl.text = "Select a channel before changing favorites." return end if channel = m.filtered[index] url = channel.url if m.favorites.doesExist(url) keys = m.favoriteSection.GetKeyList() for each key in keys if m.favoriteSection.Read(key) = url m.favoriteSection.Delete(key) exit for end if end for m.favorites.Delete(url) m.favoriteCount = m.favoriteCount - 1 removeFavoriteChannel(url) if not m.favoriteSection.Flush() m.statusLbl.text = "Could not save the favorites list." m.statusLbl.color = m.cRed return end if m.statusLbl.text = "Removed from Favorites: " + channel.name else keys = m.favoriteSection.GetKeyList() keyIndex = 1 key = "favorite_" + stri(keyIndex).trim() keyInUse = true while keyInUse keyInUse = false if keys <> invalid for each existingKey in keys if existingKey = key keyInUse = true exit for end if end for end if if keyInUse keyIndex = keyIndex + 1 key = "favorite_" + stri(keyIndex).trim() end if end while if not m.favoriteSection.Write(key, url) or not m.favoriteSection.Flush() m.statusLbl.text = "Could not save the favorites list." m.statusLbl.color = m.cRed return end if m.favorites[url] = true m.favoriteCount = m.favoriteCount + 1 m.favoritesChannels.push(channel) m.statusLbl.text = "Added to Favorites: " + channel.name end if m.statusLbl.color = m.cGreen filterGroup() renderGroups() renderStreams() end sub
sub removeFavoriteChannel(url as String) for i = 0 to m.favoritesChannels.count() - 1 if m.favoritesChannels[i].url = url m.favoritesChannels.delete(i) return end if end for end sub
sub renderGroups() while m.groupList.getChildCount() > 0 m.groupList.removeChildIndex(0) end while if m.groups.count() = 0 lbl = m.groupList.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [12, 10] lbl.text = "No categories are available." lbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" lbl.color = m.cSub return end if y = 0 startI = m.groupOffset endI = startI + m.maxRows - 1 if endI >= m.groups.count() then endI = m.groups.count() - 1 for i = startI to endI isSel = (i = m.groupIdx) and (m.focusSide = "group") isActive = (i = m.groupIdx) rowBg = m.groupList.createChild("Rectangle") rowBg.translation = [0, y] rowBg.width = m.leftW rowBg.height = m.rowH - 2 if isSel rowBg.color = m.cSel else if isActive rowBg.color = "0x21262DFF" else rowBg.color = m.cBg end if lbl = m.groupList.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [12, y + 10] if m.groups[i] = "About Me" lbl.text = "About Me (OK)" else if m.groups[i] = "Search" lbl.text = "Search channels (OK)" else lbl.text = m.groups[i] + " (" + stri(countGroup(m.groups[i])).trim() + ")" end if lbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" if isActive then lbl.color = m.cText else lbl.color = m.cSub lbl.width = m.leftW - 16 lbl.truncateOnDelimiter = "..." y = y + m.rowH end for end sub
sub renderStreams() while m.streamList.getChildCount() > 0 m.streamList.removeChildIndex(0) end while if m.focusSide = "stream" and m.streamOffset + m.streamCursor < m.filtered.count() selected = m.filtered[m.streamOffset + m.streamCursor] m.top.previewChannel = { name: selected.name, url: selected.url, stream_format: selected.stream_format, http_headers: selected.http_headers } end if if m.filtered.count() = 0 lbl = m.streamList.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [12, 10] lbl.text = "No channels." lbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" lbl.color = m.cSub updateDetails() return end if chW = 920 y = 0 endIdx = m.streamOffset + m.maxRows - 1 if endIdx >= m.filtered.count() then endIdx = m.filtered.count() - 1 for i = m.streamOffset to endIdx s = m.filtered[i] localI = i - m.streamOffset isSel = (localI = m.streamCursor) and (m.focusSide = "stream") rowBg = m.streamList.createChild("Rectangle") rowBg.translation = [0, y] rowBg.width = chW rowBg.height = m.rowH - 2 if isSel rowBg.color = m.cSel else if i mod 2 = 0 rowBg.color = m.cBg else rowBg.color = "0x161B22FF" end if numLbl = m.streamList.createChild("Label") numLbl.translation = [10, y + 10] numLbl.text = stri(i + 1).trim() numLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" numLbl.color = m.cSub numLbl.width = 52 nameX = 66 if s.logo <> invalid and s.logo <> "" poster = m.streamList.createChild("Poster") poster.translation = [66, y + 4] poster.width = 34 poster.height = 34 poster.uri = s.logo nameX = 108 end if name = s.name if m.favorites.doesExist(s.url) then name = "[FAV] " + name nameLbl = m.streamList.createChild("Label") nameLbl.translation = [nameX, y + 4] nameLbl.text = name nameLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" if isSel then nameLbl.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" else nameLbl.color = m.cText nameLbl.width = chW - nameX - 12 nameLbl.truncateOnDelimiter = "..." groupName = s.group if groupName = invalid or groupName = "" then groupName = "Uncategorized" format = s.stream_format if format = invalid or format = "" then format = "hls" genre = "" if s.metadata <> invalid genre = s.metadata.genre if genre = invalid then genre = s.metadata.tvg_genre if genre = invalid then genre = s.metadata.category if genre = invalid then genre = "" end if metaLbl = m.streamList.createChild("Label") metaLbl.translation = [nameX, y + 23] metaLbl.text = groupName + " | " + format if s.program_now <> invalid and s.program_now.title <> invalid metaLbl.text = "NOW: " + s.program_now.title if s.program_next <> invalid and s.program_next.title <> invalid metaLbl.text = metaLbl.text + " | NEXT: " + s.program_next.title end if end if if genre <> "" then metaLbl.text = metaLbl.text + " | " + genre metaLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" metaLbl.color = m.cSub metaLbl.width = chW - nameX - 12 y = y + m.rowH end for if m.filtered.count() > m.maxRows hint = m.streamList.createChild("Label") hint.translation = [10, y + 6] hint.text = "^v scroll (" + stri(m.filtered.count()).trim() + " total)" hint.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" hint.color = m.cSub end if updateDetails() end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if m.aboutVisible or m.webToolsVisible if key = "back" if m.aboutVisible m.aboutVisible = false m.aboutOverlay.visible = false else m.webToolsVisible = false m.webToolsOverlay.visible = false end if end if return true end if if key = "options" return openOptionsDialog() end if if m.focusSide = "group" if key = "up" if m.groupIdx > 0 m.groupIdx = m.groupIdx - 1 if m.groupIdx < m.groupOffset then m.groupOffset = m.groupIdx filterGroup() renderGroups() renderStreams() end if return true else if key = "down" if m.groupIdx < m.groups.count() - 1 m.groupIdx = m.groupIdx + 1 if m.groupIdx >= m.groupOffset + m.maxRows m.groupOffset = m.groupIdx - m.maxRows + 1 end if filterGroup() renderGroups() renderStreams() end if return true else if key = "right" if m.groups[m.groupIdx] = "About Me" openAboutMe() else if m.groups[m.groupIdx] = "Web Tools Links" openWebTools() else if m.groups[m.groupIdx] = "Search" openSearchDialog() else if m.filtered.count() > 0 m.focusSide = "stream" renderGroups() renderStreams() end if return true else if key = "OK" if m.groups[m.groupIdx] = "About Me" openAboutMe() else if m.groups[m.groupIdx] = "Web Tools Links" openWebTools() else if m.groups[m.groupIdx] = "Search" openSearchDialog() else if m.filtered.count() > 0 playChannel(0) else m.statusLbl.text = "There are no channels in this view." end if return true else if key = "replay" resetPlaylist() m.statusLbl.text = "Reloading..." m.statusLbl.color = m.cSub m.task.url = "" m.task.url = m.m3uUrl return true end if else if key = "left" m.focusSide = "group" renderGroups() renderStreams() return true else if key = "up" if m.streamCursor > 0 m.streamCursor = m.streamCursor - 1 else if m.streamOffset > 0 m.streamOffset = m.streamOffset - 1 end if renderStreams() return true else if key = "down" maxC = m.maxRows - 1 totalC = m.filtered.count() - 1 if m.streamCursor < maxC and (m.streamOffset + m.streamCursor) < totalC m.streamCursor = m.streamCursor + 1 else if m.streamOffset + m.maxRows < m.filtered.count() m.streamOffset = m.streamOffset + 1 end if renderStreams() return true else if key = "OK" idx = m.streamOffset + m.streamCursor playChannel(idx) return true else if key = "play" toggleFavorite() return true else if key = "replay" filterGroup() renderStreams() return true end if end if return false end function
sub playChannel(index as Integer) if index < 0 or index >= m.filtered.count() then return stream = m.filtered[index] if stream.url = "" then return channel = { name: stream.name, url: stream.url, group: stream.group, logo: stream.logo, category: stream.category, tvg_id: stream.tvg_id, duration: stream.duration, metadata: stream.metadata, stream_format: stream.stream_format, http_headers: stream.http_headers ,program_now: stream.program_now ,program_next: stream.program_next } m.statusLbl.text = "> NOW PLAYING: " + stream.name m.statusLbl.color = m.cGreen m.top.selectedChannel = channel end sub
